## ✨ Highlights

A reliability release: what replacing kluster-prod's and demo-vrrp's members on v2026.11.03 showed, and what v2026.11.02-2's lab campaign found.

- 🤝 **A node just admitted no longer shows "needs the recovery kit"** ([#518](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/518)): a new machine's node was refused while it took the fleet's trust, and showed the alarm for up to 10 minutes.
- 🛡️ **No SELinux denial on Proxmox VMs any more** ([#519](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/519)): every node made on Proxmox VE logged one at boot, for the USB tablet Proxmox gives a VM.
- 🪂 **A Controller that has been a standby updates through its updater again** ([#482](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/482)).

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **A Controller on v2026.11.02 or v2026.11.02-2 that has been a standby**: its updater stops at its backup, on the socket the standby left behind (`ha/control.sock`). Before updating it, delete that socket from its data directory. A Controller that is a standby right now: update it by hand (`JANUS_CONTROLLER_IMAGE`, then `docker compose up -d`). See the [standby guide](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/controller-standby.md).

## 🖥️ Controller

- **The fleet's trust, checked right** ([#518](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/518)):
  - A node admitted less than two minutes ago that refuses the fleet's certificate isn't taken for one needing the recovery kit any more: it is tried again 15 s later, and its tooltip says it was just admitted. Admitting a node checks it at once, while the node takes the fleet's trust from its registration's answer a moment later - at its next poll, within 15 s, when someone approves it.
  - A node refusing a certificate is recognised as such even when its TLS alert is lost: TLS 1.3 checks the client's certificate after the handshake, and the node's close can come as a reset. The Controller took that for a dead connection and waited for the node until its 30 s deadline, then reported "context deadline exceeded" instead of reaching the node with another certificate - the same race made `TestRenewTheFleet` fail in CI.
- **What a standby leaves behind** ([#482](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/482)):
  - a stale `ha/control.sock` is removed at start, and the updater's copy leaves sockets out;
  - `ha/previous/` keeps the two newest set-asides - each one a whole data directory, all copied by the updater while the Controller is stopped (an update went 14.6 s without an answer instead of 4.6 s);
  - right after a switch-over, the promoted Controller answers the new standby's first copy with "just promoted" and `Retry-After: 5`, and `ha status` no longer shows the copy of an earlier epoch.

## ⚙️ Node

- **USB devices' nodes** ([#519](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/519)): the kernel's devtmpfs thread may make and remove `/dev/bus/usb/…` once the policy is loaded - the tablet Proxmox gives every VM, a USB device plugged in or taken out. The SELinux test now boots with Proxmox's USB hardware and plugs a device in and out.
- **A refused update of an uploaded root filesystem says the slot holds the upload** ([#514](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/514)): `upload-release` and the Controller's relay write `rootfs.squashfs` straight into the other slot; refusing it then said "nothing was written". It now says the slot holds that upload, not its previous release, and to upload a sound bundle before updating.
